blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior and complete grounding. With controlled adaptation, Gemma-4-12B reaches 63.29% on this joint capability, nearly tripling its zero-shot performance. Qwen3-VL-8B exhibits the same broad improvement in evidence-sensitive answering and grounding. These results show that semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are distinct capabilities that should be evaluated jointly.
blocks.zh: 可靠的驱动VLM必须做更多的工作,不只是正确回答或者将相关现场角色定位:他们必须确定现有的视觉证据是否足以支持一个答案. 现有评价基本上将地面定位和可回答性作为单独的衡量标准,因此难以区分得到充分支持的预测与地方预测和相关的但不充分的证据。 我们引入了DriveAnswer(DriveAnswer)这一基准,该基准涉及7个推理家庭的20,151个问题,它利用匹配的强证据和弱证据配置来实施这种区分。 每对都保留了基本的场景事实和语义解答,同时改变观察是否支持回答,使弃权在弱证据下的适当回应. 在6个家庭的评价中,最强的零射线基线达到了67.31%的强证据准确度,然而只有21.55%的对应问题既满足了解答缺陷的行为,也满足了完整的地平线. 随着受控的适应,Gemma-4-12B在这个联合能力上达到了63.29%,几乎是其零发性能的三倍. Qune3-VL-8B在注重证据的回答和基础方面显示出同样的广泛改进。 这些结果表明,语义正确性、证据充足性和地基性是不同的能力,应当共同评价。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision–language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to interpret complex driving scenes and support perception, prediction, and planning. Hence, specialized benchmarks are increasingly necessary to systematically identify model vulnerabilities in such a critical domain. While recent benchmarks such as nuScenes-QA, DriveLM, and GraphVQA have substantially advanced the evaluation of driving VLMs, they primarily measure models’ answer correctness rather than their ability to recognize and utilize required evidence when answering [ 23 , 25 , 15 ] . This distinction is important because autonomous driving observations are constantly under partial observability: a road user may be occluded, outside the queried camera, or visible without temporal context. Under these circumstances, a model may still recover the correct label from priors or partial cues and receive QA credit. Robustness benchmarks thus show VLMs’ undesirable responsiveness under weak inputs [ 34 ] , while selective prediction encourages abstention under uncertainty [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 愿景-语言模型(VLMs)被越来越多地用于解释复杂的驱动场景和支持感知,预测和规划. 因此,越来越有必要制定专门的基准,以系统地查明这一关键领域的模型脆弱性。 虽然最近的基准,如nuScens-QA、DriveLM和GraphVQA大大推动了对驱动VLM的评估,但它们主要衡量模型的答案正确性,而不是在回答[23、25、15]时识别和利用所需证据的能力。 这种区分很重要,因为自主的驾驶观测经常处于部分可观察性之下:道路使用者可能被困住,在被询问的相机之外,或者在没有时间背景的情况下可见。 在这种情况下,一个模型仍可从先前或部分提示中取回正确的标签并获得质量保证信贷。 因此,稳健性基准表明,在投入不足的情况下,VLMs的不良反应性[34],而选择性预测则鼓励在不确定的情况下弃权[26]。

blocks.en: Motivated by this gap, we introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark for evaluating whether VLMs know when they have seen enough to answer . Crucially, we do not treat visual grounding as a proxy for evidence sufficiency. A model may correctly localize the relevant road user or scene region while still lacking the temporal, cross-view, or relational evidence required to support the requested inference. DriveAnswer therefore evaluates whether models can identify relevant evidence, determine whether that evidence is sufficient, and answer or abstain accordingly.
blocks.zh: 藉由这一差距, 我们引入了DriveAnswer, 关键是,我们不把视地定位作为证据充足性的代名词。 一个模型可以正确确定相关道路使用者或景区的位置,同时仍然缺乏支持所请求的推断所需的时间、交叉视图或关系证据。 DriveAnswer因此评价模型是否能够识别出相关证据,确定该证据是否足够,并做出相应的回答或弃权.

blocks.en: Contributions. We make four contributions: (1) an evidence-sufficient driving evaluation protocol in which correctness depends not only on the semantic answer but also on whether the admitted observations support producing it; (2) a 20,151-question training and benchmark dataset spanning seven reasoning families, with matched strong-weak evidence interventions that preserve the underlying scene fact and question while changing answer sufficiency; (3) evaluation metrics that separately expose semantic answering error, unsupported commitment, unnecessary abstention, and failures to localize the required visual evidence; and (4) a controlled staged adaptation that separately studies answer sufficiency, grounding, and explicit matched-pair supervision. The adaptation results show substantial gains in evidence-sensitive answering, while also revealing that these capabilities respond differently to the corresponding supervision signals.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 我们作出了四项贡献:(1) 证据充分的驱动评价程序,其正确性不仅取决于语义答案,还取决于所接受的观测是否支持生成该方法;(2) 20 151个问题培训和基准数据集,涵盖7个推理家庭,配有相应的强弱证据干预,既能保护基本场景事实和问题,又能改变答案的充分性;(3) 评估指标,分别暴露语义回答错误、不支持承诺、不必要的弃权以及未能将所需的视觉证据本地化;和(4) 有控制的阶段调整,分别研究是否充分、确定和明确对应监督。 适应结果表明,在注重证据的回答方面有了很大进展,同时也表明这些能力对相应的监督信号的反应不同。

blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark Construction Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准建筑概况

blocks.en:
We separately construct scene truth , observation-level visual support , and question-specific evidence requirements to create matched strong and weak configurations while preserving the underlying scene fact and question semantics. The construction pipeline proceeds from a query-independent scene representation to question-specific evidence configurations. For each eligible
scene fact, we: (i) identify a verified world-state fact, (ii) generate a question targeting that fact, (iii) recover the semantic reference answer independently, (iv) specify the mandatory evidence units required to support the answer, (v) identify the camera observations and grounding targets that instantiate those units, (vi) determine whether each required evidence unit is supported by the admitted
observations, (vii) aggregate those support states into a configuration-level sufficiency
label, (viii) construct matched strong and weak configurations, and (ix) apply automatic integrity checks followed by targeted human review where needed.

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Layered Representation
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 分层代表制

blocks.en:
DriveAnswer uses four linked representations to keep semantic truth, visual
observability, and question-specific evidence requirements distinct.
blocks.zh:
Drive Answer 使用四个相联的表达方式来保持语义真实,视觉
可观察性和特定问题的证据要求是不同的。

blocks.en:
Layer 1: query-independent scene representation. The first layer describes the observable driving scene independently of any
particular benchmark question. It provides the scene-level entities, temporal
context, camera observations, and identifiers needed to construct candidate
examples without conditioning the representation on a downstream query.
blocks.zh:
第1层:查询-独立场景表现. 第一层描述的是可观察到的驾驶场 独立于任何
特别基准问题。 它提供场景级的实体,时间
建构候选人所需的背景、相机观测和识别资料
在下游查询中不限制表示的示例。

blocks.en:
Layer 2: privileged world-state graph. The second layer encodes verified entities, attributes, and relations in the
underlying scene. This layer is used to establish semantic scene truth and to
identify eligible facts from which questions can be constructed. Graphs are hidden privileged entities.
blocks.zh:
第二层:特权世界状态图. 第二层编码了已核实的实体、属性和关系
内幕 此图层用于建立语义场景真实性和
查明可据以构建问题的合格事实。 图表是隐藏的特权实体。

blocks.en: Layer 3: observation-level evidence candidates. The third layer links relevant world-state entities and relations to the camera observations in which they may be visually supported. It records projection and observation provenance together with cues such as visibility, truncation, occlusion, temporal continuity, and synchronized cross-view support. These signals identify candidate evidence and difficult observation conditions; they do not determine whether a question is answerable. However, a valid projection does not establish that the queried fact is recoverable from the observation. Thus, world-state verification determines what is true , whereas question-specific evidence determines whether that truth can be justified from the observations supplied to the model.
blocks.zh: 第3层:观察级证据候选人。 第三层将相关的世界国家实体和关系与相机观测联系起来,在相机观测中它们可能被视觉支持. 它记录了投影和观测出处,以及能见度,截取,隐入等提示,时间连续性,以及同步交叉视图支持等. 这些信号确定了备选证据和困难的观察条件;它们不能确定一个问题是否可以回答。 然而,有效的预测不能证明所询问的事实可以从观察中收回。 因此,世界状态核查决定了什么是真实的,而针对特定问题的证据则决定从提供给模型的观察中是否可以证明真相。

blocks.en:

particular question. Each required unit is associated with its relevant
observations and grounding targets, and each admitted configuration is assigned
a support state. A configuration is sufficient only when all mandatory evidence
units are supported. Strong configurations retain sufficient evidence, whereas
matched weak configurations remove or withhold at least one mandatory unit
while preserving the same underlying scene fact and question.

blocks.zh: 4.1.2 问题和证据的构建

blocks.en:
For each eligible world-state fact, the benchmark constructs a question targeting that fact, while the semantic reference answer is recovered independently from the verified scene representation. We employ Qwen3-VL-8B [ 1 ] to assist question generation using a predefined template. Qwen is used only to verbalize questions and referring expressions; reference answers and sufficiency labels are derived independently from verified construction records. Qwen proposes natural-language referring expressions from the construction-only target regions (e.g., object category, appearance, and coarse
image position). These generated attributes are not treated as semantic ground
truth, but as candidates. A candidate is retained only if the intended target is visually identifiable,
the description is unique in the admitted observation, same-category
distractors are accounted for, and the wording does not reveal the queried
relation or reference answer. Descriptions containing unsupported or unstable
attributes are rewritten or rejected. We then specify the mandatory evidence units required to justify that answer. These requirements are family specific and are defined in Appendix A.3.2 . These constructions are separate from model evaluation. The benchmarked model receives the
original unboxed observation; construction-only regions are never exposed at
evaluation time.

DriveAnswer spans seven reasoning families. The six canonical scene-understanding
families are Spatial Relation , Map Relation , Motion State , Temporal Relation , Temporal Recovery , and Cross-View Recovery . Together they test whether the model can answer questions with spatial, map, motion,
temporal, and multi-view scene properties. Evidence-Conditioned Decision extends the same
matched-evidence framework to a decision policy and is evaluated separately as a policy-conditioned extension rather than as
online driving-policy evaluation. The Evidence-conditioned Decision construction details are provided in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Review and Reconciliation
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 审查与和解

blocks.en:
Human Validation. Automatic checks cannot fully resolve cases in which visual support is
borderline, multiple interpretations remain plausible, or annotation sources
disagree. Such cases are routed to targeted manual review. Review focuses on three questions:
(1) whether the reference answer is supported by the verified scene semantics,
(2) whether the designated observations actually support each mandatory
evidence unit, and
(3) whether the resulting strong-weak sufficiency distinction is unambiguous. When annotation components disagree, we reconcile them manually so that
a semantic disagreement is resolved at the world-state level; and an
observation-support disagreement is resolved by reviewing the admitted visual
evidence and the family-specific evidence requirement. Cases that remain genuinely ambiguous after reconciliation are excluded to prevent annotation uncertainty, while difficult but solvable cases are retained. We additionally perform benchmark-level audits over graph construction,
projection coverage, evidence reconstruction, support consistency, and sampled
human validation (see Appendices A.7 and A.6 ).

blocks.en:
DriveAnswer reports complementary metrics designed around the matched
strong–weak evidence intervention. Strong Semantic Accuracy (Strong) measures answer correctness when sufficient evidence is available, whereas Weak Abstention Accuracy (Weak) measures whether the model abstains
after critical evidence is removed. Our primary evidence-sufficiency
metric, Matched-Pair Success (Pair) , requires both behaviors for the
same question. Unsupported Commitment Rate (UCR) measures answering under insufficient evidence, while Unnecessary Abstention Rate (UAR) measures abstaining despite
sufficient evidence.

blocks.en:
Answer behavior alone does not establish whether a model can identify the
visual evidence supporting its prediction, highlighting the importance of grounding evaluation. A predicted region is considered correctly localized when its intersection-over-union with the reference region satisfies IoU ≥ t \geq t . Using this threshold, we measure evidence-presence accuracy ( Presence ), the ratio of correcty grounded target at t t ( IoU@ t t ), and joint presence-localization success ( Joint@ t t ). Because a question may require multiple grounding targets, All-G@ t t requires every target associated with the question to achieve Joint@ t t success. Joint Answer–Grounding Success (JAGS@ t t ) additionally requires Pair Success together with correct grounding of all required evidence.
These metrics expose complementary failure modes in semantic answering,
evidence sufficiency, and grounding.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
DriveAnswer exposes a gap between producing a correct semantic answer and
determining whether the available observations justify that answer. Across all five zero-shot models, Pair Success is substantially lower than Strong Semantic Accuracy, showing that QA performance can remain high even when models fail to respond to missing evidence. Grounding provides a complementary diagnostic: correctly localizing relevant content does not guarantee translation to correct answer-abstain behavior. For both Gemma and Qwen, evidence-sufficiency supervision accounts
for a large gain in matched-pair behavior, grounding supervision produces a
large localization improvement, while explicit coupling adds only
family-specific improvements. The cross-backbone comparison therefore supports the broader
conclusion that semantic answering, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are related but distinct capabilities that are best understood through joint evaluation.

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work. DriveAnswer is currently constructed from nuScenes and therefore inherits its sensors, geographic coverage, annotation ontology, and temporal sampling. Future work will extend the benchmark to additional domains. Our adaptation study involves two VLM architectures that exhibit a similar trend, providing initial evidence that the observed improvements are not backbone-specific, but broader evaluation across model scales and architectures would strengthen this conclusion. Finally, evidence sufficiency is inherently question-dependent. Thus, the limited number of families also confines the benchmark’s scope to the predefined tasks. Further work could include more diverse tasks and edge case tasks to ensure better generalization.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced DriveAnswer, a matched-evidence benchmark for evaluating reliable driving reasoning beyond answer correctness by jointly considering semantic accuracy, evidence sufficiency, and visual grounding. Its matched strong-weak construction tests whether models can answer when evidence is sufficient, abstain when it is not, and ground supported predictions in the relevant observations. Our results show that these capabilities can diverge substantially and benefit from being evaluated together. More broadly, reliable multimodal reasoning requires not only finding relevant evidence, but recognizing when that evidence is sufficient to justify an answer.

blocks.en: B.3 Visibility Triage Rather Than Visibility Truth
blocks.zh: B.3 可见分辨而非可见分辨真相

blocks.en: The visibility procedure was enforced because geometric projection and source visibility metadata are useful but incomplete. The augmentation therefore combines several cues such as target size, boundary truncation, source visibility, estimated occlusion, foreground overlap/crowding, and blur when measurable into a review-routing record. We freeze the routing thresholds only after calibration on labeled cases. The exact score is not released as a truth label because two observations with similar risk can differ in whether the evidence needed by a particular question is actually identifiable. This distinction is notable for occlusion. Partial occlusion does not automatically imply abstention. blocks.en: The family-level results reveal distinct grounding failure modes across reasoning types as detailed in Table 20 . Spatial Relation and Map Relation are favorable for Gemma and Qwen, both of which achieve substantially higher target-level Joint@0.5 and question-level All-G@0.5 than the remaining zero-shot models. Temporal Recovery is also relatively successful for Gemma at the target level, although complete-evidence recovery remains considerably lower. Cross-view Recovery and Decision are substantially harder since target-level grounding does not reliably translate into complete question-level evidence recovery (Qwen reaches 23.38% for Joint@0.5 but only 2.99% for All-G@0.5). Decision is similarly challenging, with high presence accuracy among many models but weak localization and JAGS, indicating that detecting relevant actors is substantially easier than localizing the complete evidence needed for meaningful answering. The weaker grounding models exhibit this discrepancy among the majority of reasoning tasks. Together, the zero-shot models support the joint reporting of presence detection, target localization, complete evidence recovery, and matched evidence-answering because they simultaneously measure different aspects of models’ performance.

blocks.en: Sufficiency and Grounding Supervision Drive Most Adaptation Gains. The adaptation results in Tables 25 and 28 show that the largest change from zero-shot behavior comes from supervising evidence-conditioned answering. Both adapted backbones achieve high abstention accuracy and Pair Success while preserving answering accuracy under supported condition. Here, Gemma-C reaches 81.58% Strong Accuracy, 98.93% Weak Abstention Accuracy, and 80.68% Pair Success. Qwen-C shows the same overall pattern at a slightly higher QA level, reaching 83.95% Strong Accuracy, 98.53% Weak Abstention Accuracy, and 82.78% Pair Success. Thus, evidence-sensitive answering is not specific to a single backbone.
blocks.zh: 充足性和地基监管驱动了大多数适应收益。 表25和表28的调整结果显示,与零镜头行为相比,最大的变化来自监督有证据条件的回答。 两种调整后的主干线都实现了高弃权精确度和Pair成功率,同时在支持的条件下保持了回答准确度. 在这里,Gemma-C达到了81.58%的强精确度,98.93%的弱弃置率 准确度,80.68%的对等成功. 温 C在略高的质量保证水平上显示出相同的总体模式,达到83.95%的强准确度,98.53%的弱缺精度,82.78%的对等成功. 因此,对证据有敏感认识的回答并不针对单一的主干。

blocks.en:
Grounding is evaluated through a prediction of presence and, when found, observation index and normalized box. Construction boxes are hidden from the model and used only for scoring. On the test set, the Gemma-C model reaches 96.82% presence accuracy, 76.67% localization accuracy at IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 , and 77.16% joint presence-localization success. Stage D changes these aggregate grounding results minimally, reaching 97.03% presence accuracy, 76.76% IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 , and 77.43% Joint@0.5. Similarly, Qwen-C reaches 96.45% presence accuracy, 74.01%
localization accuracy at IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 , and 74.71% joint
presence–localization success. Stage D is similar, with 96.49%
presence accuracy, 73.70% localization accuracy at IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 ,
and 74.46% joint presence–localization success. Thus, these results show that grounding supervision substantially improves the adapted models’ localization capabilities and that the additional Stage D pair objective does not produce a uniform aggregate localization improvement beyond explicit grounding supervision. Despite their differences in their zero-shot behavior, the two backbones converge to similar evidence-supported performance after adaptation. Qwen retains slightly stronger strong-condition understanding, whereas Gemma attains slightly stronger grounding and question-level evidence completion.

blocks.en: Explicit matched-pair objective Does Not Produce Uniform Improvements. The explicit matched-pair ranking objective in Stage D has a family-dependent effect. For Gemma, Stage D slightly increases Joint@0.5 from 77.16% to 77.43% and All-G@0.5 from 72.58% to 73.19%, but Strong Accuracy falls from 81.58% to 78.87%, Pair Success from 80.68% to 78.13%, and JAGS@0.5 from 61.79% to 59.41%. Qwen shows an even smaller C-D difference: Pair Success changes from 82.78% to 82.25%, Joint@0.5 from 74.71% to 74.45%, and JAGS@0.5 from 61.12% to 60.62%. These results suggest that explicit pair coupling is not a universally additive improvement once sufficiency and grounding supervision are already present; its effect is small and can vary by backbone and question family. For both backbones, spatial and motion questions are among the strongest evidence-supported categories. Gemma-C reaches 81.91% JAGS@0.5 on spatial relation and 75.02% on motion state, while Qwen reaches 83.64% and 75.38%, respectively as seen in Table 28 . In contrast, Decision remains substantially harder: JAGS@0.5 is only 12.42% for Gemma C and 13.66% for Qwen-C, despite much higher Pair Success. Map Relation reveals another challenge: JAGS@0.5 near 38–39% for both backbones, while
temporal relation remains more difficult at 31.28% for Gemma-C and 24.43%
for Qwen-C. The family-level comparison thus reveals the differences and challenges that each family poses for the adapted models.

blocks.en: Appendix H Qualitative Examples and Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 附录H 定性实例和失败模式

blocks.en:
This section provides qualitative examples for six scene-understanding families. All examples use the original nuScenes [ 2 ] camera frames; DriveAnswer
introduces no blur, degradation, or other image-quality modification.
blocks.zh:
本节为六个现场了解的家庭提供了定性实例。 所有示例使用原始 nuscases [2] 相机框架; DriveAnswer
没有引入模糊,降解,或其他图像质量修改.

blocks.en: H.1 Spatial and Map Reasoning
blocks.zh: H.1 空间和地图原因

blocks.en:
Spatial and map examples illustrate that preserving an object in view
does not necessarily preserve the evidence required to establish its
relationship to another entity or to mapped scene structure. These
examples as illustrated in Figures 3 and 4 are useful for distinguishing target visibility
from relation sufficiency.
blocks.zh:
空间和地图示例表明,在视图中保护物体
不一定保留证明其
与另一个实体或映射场景结构的关系。 这些
图3和图4所示实例有助于区分目标可见度。
从关系的充分性。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Spatial Relation example. The strong configuration preserves the visual support needed to establish the target’s relation to the ego, whereas the weak configuration withholds critical target evidence while preserving the underlying scene fact.
blocks.zh: 图3:空间关系实例。 强配置保留了确定目标与自负关系所需的视觉支持,而弱配置则保留了关键目标证据,同时保留了基本场景事实.

blocks.en: These examples illustrate two distinct recover mechanisms. Cross-view Recovery restores evidence through a synchronized alternative camera, whereas Temporal Recovery restores evidence through neighboring time steps. in both cases, the anchor observation alone is insufficient for question answering, so successful behavior requires using the additional admitted evidence defined by the each family.
blocks.zh: 这些例子说明了两种不同的恢复机制。 交叉视图恢复通过同步替代相机恢复证据,而临时恢复则通过相邻的时间步骤恢复证据. 在这两种情况下,仅靠锚观察不足以回答问题,所以成功的行为需要使用由每个家庭定义的额外认可的证据.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Map Relation example. The strong configuration jointly supports the queried actor and its relation to mapped scene structure, whereas the weak configuration removes critical visual support required to establish that relation.
blocks.zh: 图4:地图关系实例。 强配置共同支持被询问的演员及其与所映射的场景结构的关系,而弱配置则去除建立这种关系所需的关键视觉支持.

blocks.en: The temporal examples further show why object visibility alone is insufficient. The queried actor may remain identifiable in the weak configuration, while the sequence no longer support answers about its motion or the evolution of its relation to another actor.
blocks.zh: 时间性的例子进一步表明,单凭物体的能见度是不够的。 被询问的演员可能在弱配置中仍然可以识别,而序列不再支持对其运动或与另一个演员关系的演变的答案.

blocks.en: H.2 Cross-view and Temporal Recovery
blocks.zh: H.2 交叉观点和时间恢复

blocks.en:
Recovery examples require that the designated anchor observation be
insufficient by itself. Cross-view recovery adds a synchronized camera
that restores the missing evidence, while temporal recovery adds a
nearby time step. Examples in which the anchor already determines the
answer are treated as controls rather than as genuine recovery cases as seen in Figures 5 and 6 .
blocks.zh:
回收实例要求指定的锚地观测应
本身是不够的。 交叉视图恢复增加了同步相机
恢复缺失的证据,而时间恢复增加
附近的时间步。 锚已经决定
如图5和图6所示,答案被视为控制,而不是真正的恢复案例。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Cross-view Recovery example. The anchor observation alone is insufficient; the strong configuration provides synchronized camera view from which the queried actor can be recovered, whereas the weak sequence does not.
blocks.zh: 图5:交叉视图恢复实例。 仅靠锚观测是不够的;强配置提供了同步相机视图,被询问的演员可以从中取回,而弱序列则不能取回.

blocks.en: These recovery families test whether the model can use additional admitted observations to reconstruct evidence that is unavailable at the anchor frame. Specifically, Cross-view Recovery restores the missing evidence through synchronized alternative camera(s), whereas Temporal Recovery restores it through consecutive timesteps. The key distinction is that the semantic question and underlying scene are held fixed while the observation set changes. These families primarily focuses on whether the model can make use of additional observations when the evidence required by the question is unavailable at the anchor. A successful model should therefore answer only when the added cross-view or temporal observation restores the evidence needed for the queried inference, rather than relying on the anchor frame alone. These cases separate object visibility at a single observation from the broader question of whether the admitted observation set is sufficient to support the requested inference.
blocks.zh: 这些恢复家庭测试模型是否能够使用额外的被承认的观测数据来重建锚架上无法提供的证据. 具体而言,交叉视图恢复通过同步替代相机恢复缺失的证据,而临时恢复则通过相接的时序恢复. 关键区别在于语义问题和基础场景在观察设定变化时被固定. 这些家庭主要侧重于当问题所要求的证据在锚地无法找到时,模型是否可以利用其他观察。 因此,成功的模型只有在增加的交叉视图或时间观察恢复被询问推断所需的证据时才能回答,而不是仅仅依靠锚架。 这些案件在单一观察中将物体能见度与所接受的观察组是否足以支持所请求的推论这一更广泛的问题分开。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Temporal Recovery example. The anchor observation alone is insufficient; the strong configuration provides neighboring temporal observations that recover the missing evidence, whereas the weak sequence does not.
blocks.zh: 图6:临时恢复的例子。 仅靠锚观测是不够的;强配置提供了相邻的时间观测,可以找回缺失的证据,而弱序列则不能.

blocks.en: H.3 Motion State and Temporal Reasoning
blocks.zh: H.3. 动议状态和临时理由

blocks.en:
Motion-state and temporal-relation examples use temporally separated
observations of the same scene. A single clear anchor image may be
sufficient to recognize an object while remaining insufficient to infer
whether it is moving or how its relation to another actor changes over
time. In qualitative visualizations in Figures 7 and 8 , the anchor frame may be displayed
at full emphasis and neighboring temporal frames at reduced visual
emphasis to make the temporal evidence structure explicit.
blocks.zh:
动议状态和时间关系实例使用时间分离
同一场景的观察。 单一的清晰锚地图像可能是
足以识别对象,同时又不足以推断
它是否在移动,或者它与另一个角色的关系如何改变
时间。 在图7和图8的定性可视化中,可显示主框
完全强调和相邻时间框架
强调应明确时间证据结构。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Motion State example. The strong sequence provides sufficient temporal evidence to infer the queried actor’s motion, whereas the weak sequence preserves partial observations without enough temporal support to determine its motion state.
blocks.zh: 图7:国家动议实例。 强烈的序列提供了足够的时间证据来推断被询问的行为者的运动,而弱的序列保留了部分观测,而没有足够的时间支持来确定其运动状态.

blocks.en: Motion state and temporal relation use temporally separated observations of the same scene. A single clear anchor image may be sufficient to recognize an actor while remaining insufficient to infer whether it is moving or how its relation to another actor changes over time. These temporal families are intentionally different from recovery in that the relevant actor may remain visible throughout the sequence, while the requested property cannot be established from appearance alone. Motion State requires evidence of how an actor changes across time, and Temporal Relation requires evidence of how the relation between actors evolve. The weak configurations therefore preserve partial visual content while removing enough temporal support to make the requested inference cannot be reliably answered. This distinction is important because a model can correctly identify the objects involved while still lacking the evidence needed to infer motion or temporal change. These examples therefore isolate a different failure mode from pure detection or presence errors. The benchmark asks whether the model conditions its answer on the temporal evidence actually available, rather than whether it can recognize the entities appearing in individual frames.
blocks.zh: 运动状态和时间关系使用同一场景的时间分离观测. 单一明确的锚地图像可能足以识别一个演员,而不足以推断它是否在移动,或它与另一个演员的关系如何随着时间而变化。 这些时间性家庭有意不同于恢复,因为相关行为者在整个序列中可能始终可见,而所请求的财产则不能仅凭外表确定。 动议国要求有证据表明一个行为者如何随着时间的推移而变化,而临时关系则要求有证据表明行为者之间的关系如何演变。 因此,弱配置保留了部分可视内容,同时去除足够的时间支持,以作出所请求的推断,无法可靠地回答. 这种区分很重要,因为模型能够正确识别所涉物体,同时仍然缺乏推断运动或时间变化所需的证据。 因此,这些例子将不同的故障模式与纯检测或存在错误相隔离. 该基准询问该模型是否以实际可用的时间证据作为其答案的条件,而不是它是否能够识别单个框架中出现的实体。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Temporal Relation example. The strong sequence reveals how the queried relation changes over time, whereas the weak sequence lacks sufficient temporal evidence to establish that change.
blocks.zh: 图8:临时关系实例。 强烈的序列揭示了被询问的关系如何随时间而变化,而薄弱的序列则缺乏足够的时间证据来证实这一变化.

blocks.en: Taken together, the qualitative examples show that insufficient evidence does not necessarily correspond to an absent object or an empty observation. Across the six families, the strong-weak intervention primarily changes the evidence required for the queried inference rather than simply removing the required object. The examples therefore illustrate the benchmarks’ central distinction between observing relevant content and having sufficient evidence to justify an answer. Conversely, the strong condition adds only the evidence needed to support the same underlying semantic question. These examples visualize the core benchmark distinction between observing relevant scene content and having sufficient evidence to support the requested inference.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,定性实例表明,证据不足不一定与缺失的物体或空洞观察相对应。 在6个家庭,强弱的干预主要改变被询问推断所需的证据,而不是简单地去除所要求的对象。 因此,这些例子说明了基准在观察相关内容和有充分证据证明有理由作出答复之间的中心区别。 反之,强烈的条件只增加了支持同一语义问题所需的证据。 这些例子可视化核心基准在观察相关场景内容和有充分证据支持所请求的推断之间的区别.
